items.title: Airbnb faces potential new restrictions as EU proposes clampdown on holiday rentals
items.summary: The EU has drafted new rules which could lead to more restrictions for Airbnb and other short-term home rental companies.  The proposal, which will require agreement from EU countries and the European Parliament in the coming months before it passes into law, would provide the first common European framework for assessing new housing measures.  Increases in short-term holiday rentals have long been linked with shortages of affordable housing, with protests staged across Europe.
